newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi defence minister to arrive in Paris on Wednesday.
- Egyptian government to privatise telecommunications sector in 18 months.
- Saudi Arabian Fertiliser Company is expected to pay a 400 million riyal dividend to shareholders for 1996.
- International Monetary Fund lends Jordan $52 million for its economic reforms.
- Algeria plans to raise its production of phosphate to six million tonnes a year in the next few years.
- U.S. Presedent Bill Clinton says Israeli settlement plan harms the Middle East peace process.
- Linking Arab countries' electricity can save $6 billion in the next 20 years, Arab Fund for Ecomonic and Social Development chairman says.
- United Arab Emirates oil official calls for an increase in natural gas prices.
- Saudi Arabia invests $250 million in Tunisian tourism, Tunisian ambassador says.
